title: International Trade & Geoeconomics
description: I study sanctions, supply-chain dependence, import concentration, and industrial upgrading using trade panels and value-chain evidence.
methods: PPML · high-dimensional fixed effects · panel models · value-chain analysis

title: Firm-Level Finance & Panel Data
description: I use Vietnamese firm panels to examine profitability, operating efficiency, earnings composition, and cash-flow outcomes.
methods: Firm fixed effects · clustered inference · diagnostic-led model selection

title: Research Data Engineering
description: I build reproducible pipelines that turn web data, financial statements, and public documents into analysis-ready datasets.
methods: Resumable collection · schema normalization · provenance · PDF extraction · targeted OCR

title: Machine Learning for Economic Research
description: I apply classification, information retrieval, and graph methods to economic and document data, with temporal validation and model diagnostics.
methods: Temporal classification · calibration · hybrid retrieval · document embeddings · Leiden community detection

title: Development & Environmental Economics
description: I examine green growth and productive capabilities with cross-country panels and comparative econometric models.
methods: Country fixed effects · interaction models · cross-sectional OLS · robustness diagnostics

title: Trade Networks & Research Infrastructure
description: This work covers trade-network analysis, versioned statistical datasets, and document-retrieval infrastructure.
methods: Leiden communities · data provenance · schema validation · versioned pipelines

title: Optimization
description: I formulate routing and scheduling problems and evaluate search algorithms against fixed baselines and repeated runs.
methods: Adaptive metaheuristics · baseline comparison · multi-seed evaluation
